steps.prompt: At $3{:}00$ the clock hands make a right angle. Is the angle at $3{:}15$ zero? Picture the hour hand.

cards.title: Clock hands
cards.body: The minute hand moves $6^\circ$ a minute; the hour hand moves $30^\circ$ an hour, which is $0.5^\circ$ a minute. At $h{:}m$ the angle between them is $|30h - 5.5m|$ (subtract from $360$ if it's over $180$). The minute hand gains $5.5$ degrees a minute on the hour hand.

cards.title: Worked example: 4:20
cards.problem: What is the angle between the hands at $4{:}20$?

try.prompt: Where is the hour hand, in degrees from 12?

cards.title: Calendars
cards.body: Days of the week repeat every $7$ days, so count in remainders mod $7$. A normal year is $52$ weeks and $1$ day; a leap year is $52$ weeks and $2$ days. Leap years: divisible by $4$, except century years not divisible by $400$ ($1900$ no, $2000$ yes).

cards.title: Worked example: a weekday
cards.problem: Today is a Tuesday. What day of the week is it $100$ days from now?

try.prompt: What is the remainder when $100$ is divided by $7$?

steps.text: Two days after Tuesday is Thursday.

try.prompt: How many days after Tuesday is the answer?

cards.title: The common trap: the frozen hour hand
cards.body: The hour hand keeps moving while the minutes pass, so at $3{:}30$ it is halfway to $4$. And watch the off-by-one: "from Monday to Friday, including both" is $5$ days.
